scope: GOAL VII, seven cumulative gates supplied in the mandate
method: Each gate needs all its guarantees in the proposed no-billing runtime, including applicable hosted evidence. Local scenario counts are separate. Partial work is recorded, not credited as complete equivalence.

gates.name: Private exact 20 MiB bytes
gates.evidence: RTDB Emulator and official local Storage OSS, full SHA-256, interrupted TUS resume, original download; UI RTDB.
gates.remaining: Full verification/read path within Workers Free CPU/subrequests; hosted gateway/auth and token semantics.

gates.name: Tenant A/B and negative RBAC
gates.evidence: Canonical UID/member/order checks, client sharing, revocation; provider raw deny; official bucket default-deny roles.
gates.remaining: Hosted Firebase JWT or privileged broker identity, minimal secrets and end-to-end revocation/cache. Default-deny OSS RLS does not prove Firestore membership visible to Supabase.

gates.name: No-billing viable capacity
gates.evidence: Official Free/Spark limits documented; 21 tenants/42 reservations,28 admitted14 denied, no deletion.
gates.remaining: 1GB global saturates before37days even1tenant at2x20MiB/day. Account eligibility/card/billing not verified; cannot promise unchanged growing multi-tenant operation. No paid upgrade applied.

gates.name: Cross-store crash and restore
gates.evidence: RTDB20MiB+metadata snapshot/restore interrupted/resumed, SHA, preserved dates, orphan reservation/positive absence, tombstone, API delete recovery.
gates.remaining: Native Supabase restore, pending/orphan collection protocol, hosted inventory/accounting and independent operational backup/restore. No automatic abandoned upload collector accepted.

gates.name: Auditable safe retention
gates.evidence: Classes, UTC windows, hysteresis, no shortening, canonical closures, holds/legacy, all-recipient internal notices, leases,110invalid records and revision fence. DRY_RUN only.
gates.remaining: Snapshot do TXT é fonte autorizada; arquivo77 ausente registrado sem inventar conteúdo. Worker scheduled alcança broker Node local; processamento integral Free e operação hospedada ainda não aceitos.

gates.name: Download and notice UX
gates.evidence: 7 distinct E2E:320/375/768/1440,20MiB original hashes, oversize error, optional bounded PNG thumbnail, canonical notices, global pause and old public route smoke.
gates.remaining: Technical lab only, RTDB. Direct native/hosted TUS browser/CORS and all original upload consumers remain uncut; no silent functional replacement.

gates.name: Rollback to previous adapter
gates.evidence: Separate branch/namespaces, flags OFF default guards,37baseline source hashes unchanged, old public routes render; both prior remote branches preserved.
gates.remaining: No data migration performed. Old6MiB reader does not read new20MiB objects; dual-reader/export and migration rollback must be proven before any future cutover.
